verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents non-custodial stablecoin agent wallets with scoped, onchain-enforced delegation, and dedicated quickstarts for paying x402 and MPP endpoints in stablecoins (e.g., USDC/USDXM) on Base, including settlement receipt verification via getPaymentSettleResponse — this is a well-documented, rails-specific stablecoin settlement flow. Missing for 10: no independent/third-party corroboration beyond first-party docs, and no published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404s).
